brand.purpose: StudioFlow word mark in the header only.

title.purpose: Monitor scene names; pairing headings at 15.5px/700.

body.purpose: Default UI text; scene names at weight 600.

control.purpose: Buttons, header chips, segmented controls, tabs.

meta.purpose: Hints, meta lines, field labels; muted.

label.purpose: Uppercase dock titles, tally names and control-group labels; names the region it sits on, never an eyebrow.

tag.purpose: PGM / PVW tags on scene and station rows.

mono-value.purpose: Blende duration, number inputs, clock, LIVE runtime, output latency.

mono-meta.purpose: Resolution and fps, bitrate, ms, message timestamps.

mono-code.purpose: Slot codes (K1, S2, M3) on a raised chip.

mono-pair-code.purpose: Verification code while a laptop pairs.

fonts.prototypeSource: Self-hosted: prototype/fonts/sofia-sans-semi-condensed-latin.woff2 (variable, wght 1–1000, latin subset, SIL OFL 1.1)
fonts.productRequirement: Self-host in the Angular build; no external CDN, because the Regie runs in a LAN.

fonts.role: Measurements, time codes, slot codes, URLs, pairing codes
fonts.prototypeSource: Self-hosted: prototype/fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin.woff2 (variable, wght 100–800, latin subset, SIL OFL 1.1)
fonts.productRequirement: Self-host in the Angular build; no external CDN, because the Regie runs in a LAN.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Popovers, toast and dock-drag ghost only.

shadows.name: scroll-edge
shadows.value: linear-gradient(rgba(1, 4, 9, .65), rgba(1, 4, 9, 0)) 10px, masked by a panel-coloured 18px local gradient
shadows.purpose: Top and bottom fade on scrolling dock bodies while more content exists.

shadows.name: splitter-active
shadows.purpose: A hairline under hover, focus or drag becomes a 3px blue line.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.value: outline: 2px solid #79c0ff; outline-offset: 2px (-3px inside segmented groups)

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Single ease-out curve for all state changes.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, colour, switch thumb, segmented and row state changes.

motion.name: splitter-delay
motion.purpose: A hairline turns blue only after a short hover delay, so passing over it does not flicker.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Station row detail expand (grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr) and chevron rotation.

motion.name: tally-flash
motion.purpose: Program outline flashes 6px light red and settles to 2px when a scene goes live.

motion.name: lamp-pulse
motion.purpose: Station lamp halo pulses once when an outage starts, then holds its light.

motion.name: station-flash
motion.purpose: Blue wash fades out on a station row reached from the message strip.

motion.name: blende
motion.purpose: Fade transition; always runs to completion; no T-bar; new switches are ignored while it runs.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transitions and animations 0s; Blende becomes a cut

breakpoints.name: short-laptop
breakpoints.purpose: One-line scene rows with 48px thumbnails; 36px dock headers.

breakpoints.name: stacked
breakpoints.purpose: Docks stop dragging and stack as a two-column hairline grid; the page scrolls.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Single column by priority: Program, controls, Preview, docks; scenes as a horizontal strip.

layout.gutter: 16px, or the safe-area inset if larger
layout.splitterKeys: Arrow keys 16px, Shift 64px; Enter or double-click resets
layout.persistence: Layout and Studio-Modus stored per browser (localStorage keys studioflow.layout, studioflow.studio)

themes.choice: Dark | Light | System, stored per browser in localStorage["studioflow.theme"]; absent means dark.
themes.mechanism: :root carries the dark values, :root[data-theme="light"] overrides every themed token. data-theme is the resolved theme, set before first paint by theme-init.js and kept by ThemeService. Components use tokens only.

picture.note: Picture areas stay dark in both themes. Everything drawn on a picture uses these tokens.

themes.contrast: Text and state text 4.5:1 on every surface and on their own wash; lamps, tally outlines, focus rings and control borders 3:1. Checked in both themes by tools/lib/studio-theme-contrast.spec.ts.

narrative.overview:
The Regie is one continuous graphite console. There are no boxed panels, no gaps between regions and no outer frame. Header, message strip, stage and docks butt against each other and are separated only by 1px hairlines that run all the way to the window edge. The hairlines are also the handles: dragging one resizes the regions it divides. Only the content keeps a 16px gutter from the window edge. The density matches a broadcast tool on a 14–16 inch laptop: 14px body text, 30px controls and 40px dock headers.

Colour belongs to state. The neutral graphite steps carry the structure, and every saturated hue has a fixed meaning: red is Program and live, green is Preview and ok, amber is a station reconnecting, blue is selection, the primary action and the active hairline, and violet is an editable number. An outage therefore reads as colour that was not there a moment ago. Risky actions sit apart from everything else, behind a dashed red outline.

The system explicitly rejects two things. One is OBS's clutter of equal-ranking grey dock windows, in which an outage gets lost. The other is framed cards with gaps between them. The docks keep OBS's freedom: they can be moved, resized and hidden. They keep it without OBS's chrome.
keyCharacteristics: One flat surface on panel graphite (#151a22). Regions are divided by 1px seam hairlines (#262c36) that reach the window edge. Content keeps a 16px gutter.
Hairlines are interactive. They turn blue on hover or focus, a double-click resets them, and arrow keys move them.
Saturated colour appears only as state: tally, lamps, washes, dashed alert outlines and the primary action.
One compact semi-condensed grotesk for everything. Mono only for measurements, time codes and slot codes.
Depth comes from tonal steps. Shadows appear only on floating layers.
Motion is 150–200ms ease-out for state changes. An outage flashes once and then holds its light. The only longer motion is the Blende itself, and it always runs to completion.

rules.name: The State-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: A saturated hue appears only when it carries one of its five meanings. Never use red, green, amber, blue or violet as decoration, and never give a hue a second meaning.

rules.name: The Wash Rule
rules.body: A state tints a whole row or message entry with its wash (8–10% alpha) and colours its icon, lamp or label. It never fills an entire region with solid colour.

rules.name: The Picture-Stays-Dark Rule
rules.body: Monitors, thumbnails, previews and the well stay near black in the light theme. Everything drawn on a picture uses the --pic-* tokens, never the themed ones. A video picture on a white background looks flat and too dark.

rules.name: The One-Appearance Rule
rules.body: A new colour is a token in both theme maps, or a picture token. Components never contain a literal colour and never branch on the theme.

rules.name: The Instrument Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved for measurements, time codes, slot codes, URLs and pairing codes. Words in sentences, names and buttons are always set in Sofia Sans Semi Condensed.

rules.name: The Label-Is-A-Name Rule
rules.body: The uppercase label style names the dock or control group it belongs to. It is never an eyebrow or teaser above a heading.

rules.name: The Seam-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Regions sit on the surface and are divided by hairlines. Shadows belong only to things that float (popovers, toast, drag ghost).

dos: **Do** separate regions with 1px seam hairlines (#262c36) that run to the window edge, and keep content 16px from that edge.
**Do** make every region divider a resize handle: blue on hover or focus, double-click or Enter to reset, arrow keys for 16px steps (Shift for 64px).
**Do** give each saturated hue exactly one meaning: red Program and down, green Preview and ok, amber reconnecting, blue selection and primary action, violet editable number.
**Do** show an outage everywhere at once (header, message strip, monitor element, scene list, source row, station row) with lamps and washes, and keep a recovered station marked until "Gesehen".
**Do** keep the control column and the docks fixed when Studio-Modus toggles. Only the Preview monitor appears or disappears.
**Do** put risky actions behind a dashed red outline, away from other actions, with a dashed confirmation box.
**Do** set measurements, time codes, slot codes and pairing codes in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
**Do** self-host Sofia Sans Semi Condensed and JetBrains Mono in the product build.
**Do** label sample imagery and names as synthetic wherever placeholder content appears.
**Do** keep picture areas dark in the light theme and draw everything on a picture with the `--pic-*` tokens.
**Do** add every new colour as a token in both theme maps (or as a picture token), and check it with the contrast test.
donts: **Don't** box regions as cards with gaps between them, and don't frame the app with an outer border.
**Don't** add a T-bar or any control that can leave a Blende half-finished.
**Don't** use shadows on regions. Shadows are only for popovers, the toast and the drag ghost.
**Don't** use a saturated hue decoratively, including for branding, section accents or illustrations.
**Don't** use the uppercase label style as an eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
**Don't** load fonts or assets from an external CDN in the product.
**Don't** write a literal colour value in a component stylesheet or branch on the theme in a component.
**Don't** invert or lighten a picture area, or the QR code, to match the light theme.
